title: Thousand Year Old Vampire — Chronicle
description: Schema for a TYOV vampire chronicle file, compatible with the chronicle viewer.

name.description: The vampire's name. Used as the display name and filename.

vampire_desc.description: A short tagline or concept for the vampire. Displayed in the top bar.
examples: A noble knight. Has nice hair

game_start.description: The date the game started, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

modified.description: The date the chronicle was last modified, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

current_prompt.description: The most recently assigned prompt number (1-80).

epitaph.description: An optional poetic epitaph for the vampire.

marks.description: Physical marks that indicate the vampire's undying nature.

examples: The world's most perfect(ly sharp) teeth
I don't really. I smile a LOT.

status.description: Whether the mark is active or lost.

memories.description: The vampire's active memory slots. Maximum 5.

n.description: Memory slot number (1-5). Recycled when a memory is lost.

theme.description: The name or header of this memory. Empty string for an empty slot.

description.description: Optional extended description of the memory.

experiences.description: Experience summaries. Maximum 3. Empty array for an empty slot.

lost_memories.description: Memories that were lost when a 4th experience would have been added, or when a diary was lost. Ordered by lost_at ascending.

n.description: The slot number this memory occupied when lost.

theme.description: The theme of the lost memory.

experiences.description: All experiences at the time of loss.

lost_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this memory was lost.

lost_on_turn.description: The journal turn number that caused this memory to be lost.

gained_turn.description: The journal turn on which this skill was gained. 0 for skills gained at character creation.

lost_turn.description: Always null for skills — skills are checked, not lost.

resources.description: Resources the vampire possesses or has lost.

description.description: A brief description of the resource.

type.description: portable = can be taken away, stationary = fixed location, diary = a memory diary (max 1 active at a time).

status.description: Whether the resource is currently held.

gained_turn.description: The journal turn on which this resource was gained. 0 for resources gained at character creation.

lost_turn.description: The journal turn on which this resource was lost. Null if still active.

diary_memories.description: Memories stored in diary resources, keyed by diary resource name. Each diary holds up to 4 memories.

n.description: The memory slot number this memory came from.

experiences.description: The experiences stored in this diary memory. No new experiences can be added.

characters.description: All characters — mortal and immortal — encountered by the vampire.

type.description: mortal = ages and dies, immortal = undying.

description.description: A short description of the character.

status.description: Whether the character is still living.

death_epitaph.description: A short poetic inscription for the obituary.

gained_turn.description: The journal turn on which this character was met. 0 for characters from character creation.

lost_turn.description: The journal turn on which this character died. Null if still alive.

journal.description: The journal of prompts and experiences. Ordered by turn number ascending.

entry.description: The entry number within the prompt (1-3). Prompts 72-80 allow only 1 entry.

resolved.description: Whether the player has written prose and recorded a memory experience for this entry. false = awaiting resolution.

resolved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this entry was resolved. Null if still awaiting.

experience.description: The player's prose journal entry for this prompt.

changes.description: A mechanical summary of what changed: characters killed, skills gained/lost, resources changed.

resolved_memory.description: Records where the memory experience was stored, for potential undo on unresolve.
